Linda Mapindlo

Organising Team

Linda Mapindlo (Organising Team) is part of the leadership team of Young AI Leaders Gweru Hub, a youth-led artificial intelligence and technology community in Gweru, Midlands Province, Zimbabwe, and part of the Young AI Leaders Community under ITU's AI for Good.

Part of the hub's organising team, coordinating workshops, events and day-to-day operations for the Gweru Hub.
